description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR4. TypeDef (src/compiler2/typedef.rs ~22) is a hard Ty plus formal params resolved by substitution; @type t :: :start | {integer, t} deadlocks (DeriveTypeDef waits on TypeDefined(t)). Make TypeDef a one-equation system solved to a μ node; mutually recursive typedefs solve together. The binder lands declared before it is inferred. Tests: recursive_typedef_resolves_to_one_mu_identity, mutually_recursive_typedefs_resolve_together; the PR1 fixture's expected diagnostic becomes an expected value.

Acceptance:
- TypeDef resolution is the first non-test caller of the TypeInterner regular-component boundary for both self-recursive and mutually recursive declarations.
- Move that boundary out of test-only compilation; strict Clippy passes without a dead-code suppression or a synthetic startup call.
- The two recursive typedef proofs resolve one stable μ identity per root, and rerunning the same declarations leaves the type identity inventory unchanged.
